_comment: INFINITE DRAW IS A COLOUR SOURCE -- and since Session 24 the EXECUTOR can run it, so this
fixture pins the whole line end to end: OFFERED, and the harness's independent re-apply
through the public TurnSolver::ApplyPlan kills the opponent.
USER, 2026-09-11: 'Another thing that should be possible for the Blue or Black requirement is
drawing into Fertile Ground. If you have infinite draw you can always draw into Fertile
Ground and get all the colours you need.'
The board is deliberately COLOURLESS-AND-GREEN: Conservatory+Overgrowth ({G}/{W}, +{G}{G}),
a Brushland ({G}/{W}/{C}), Emiel the Blessed and two Peregrine Drakes. Not one blue or black
source anywhere, and no land Aura in play, so comborules::HasBlueOrBlackSource is false and
rules IN-HAND / WISH-DRAW / WISH-NODRAW all decline -- and FinishNeedMana refuses BOTH
sideboard finishers on colour (Dimensional Infiltrator {1}{U}, Essence Depleter {2}{B}).
The loop itself is fine: Emiel blinks for {3}, the Drake untaps five, the set is worth 4, so
net +1 and -- because Emiel spends no {C} pip -- net_c +1 off the single Brushland.
A Fertile Ground is still in the library, and a Living Wish behind it. With a repeatable draw
source live (Conservatory's {4},{T}: Investigate) the line reaches both, so the colour the
finisher's cast needs is one dig away. DigReachesAnyColorAura says so, FinishNeedMana stops
vetoing on the one colour an any-colour Aura supplies, and DeployLandAuraFromHand then CASTS
it mid-loop -- on a land the payment left untapped, so its wild is available to the Essence
Depleter cast in the same iteration. [finish] reads `wish=1 hand=1`.
ITS CONTROL IS THE EXECUTOR HALF: CO_ENV='MTG_COMBO_OFF_LAND_AURA=0' -> still offered (the
display is untouched) and NOT VERIFIED, which is precisely the state of affairs Session 22
recorded and shipped the display lever OFF for. CO_ENV='MTG_COMBO_OFF_DIG_COLOR=0' withdraws
the offer entirely. Both fail ONLY this fixture.
SIX FILLER CARDS SIT BELOW THE LIVING WISH, and that is stated rather than quietly chosen.
The draw sink NEVER DRAWS THE LAST CARD (an unbounded loop must not propose its own death),
so with the wish as card 10 of a 10-card library the board was unwinnable for a reason that
has nothing to do with colour -- an authoring artefact of the Session 22 cut, which pinned
`combo_off_verify: false` and so never noticed. The filler makes the wish REACHABLE; it adds
no colour (Forest is green, which this board already makes in quantity).
Its negative control is edf_co_25 -- the same board with every any-colour Aura gone from the
library, which must stay ABSENT.
